newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian PM to meet government amid crisis.
newsitem.headline: Albanian PM to meet government amid crisis.

text.p: Albanian Prime Minister Bashkim Fino has called a meeting of his nine-party national unity government amid a deepening crisis over planned elections, his office said on Tuesday.

Fino's spokesman said the prime minister had earlier met President Sali Berisha who had agreed to some amendments to election rules, which have caused most parties to threaten to boycott the planned June 29 vote.

European envoy Franz Vranitzky earlier issued an ultimatum to end the crisis on Tuesday but it was not known whether the amendments would be enough to convince the government parties to take part in the election.
Fino has tried to broker a compromise over the election laws, which the parties say will not guarantee fair elections and favour Berisha and his former ruling Democratic Party.
Fino earlier in the day said the crisis in Albania had deepened after marathon talks with political parties on Monday failed to find a compromise.
The elections are seen as vital to stop Albania sliding back into the violence seen earlier this year when widespread looting and rioting broke out.
